description: Inerior works comprising: new bathroom fittings; replacement boiler; new kitchen fittings; new plug sockets and light switches; replaster bedroom ceiling; painting of walls; replacement carpet; new light fittings; replacement door handles; new skirting board; replacement radiators; new drainage pipework; restore and paint outside balcony.
decision_conditions:
Detailed existing and proposed floor plans to scale required showing and annotating detailed changes.  Internal elevations required where relevant, e.g. showing existing and proposed radiators. We recommend using a professional consultant or architect with experience with Listed Buildings. Anyone can submit a planning application, but using a planning professional to ensure that the submission is valid and the quality is sufficient will minimise any delays. 

There are a number of local architects and planning consultants that can be used. We are not able to make recommendations, but you you can check:
https://www.richmond.gov.uk/services/planning/make_a_planning_application#Consider_using_a_professional
